partners.mechanism_chain: IDUA (HGNC:5391) —DISRUPTS→ Lysosomal degradation of glycosaminoglycans (GO:0000205); IDUA (HGNC:5391) —DECREASES→ Heparan Sulfate (CHEBI:16907); Heparan Sulfate (CHEBI:16907) —DISRUPTS→ Lysosomal degradation of glycosaminoglycans (GO:0000205); Lysosomal degradation of glycosaminoglycans (GO:0000205) —LEADS_TO→ Hepatosplenomegaly (HP:0001510); Lysosomal degradation of glycosaminoglycans (GO:0000205) —LEADS_TO→ Coarse facial features (HP:0000284). Loss-of-function mutations in IDUA lead to deficient alpha-L-iduronidase activity, impairing the lysosomal degradation of glycosaminoglycans, specifically heparan sulfate. **Why it matters:** Understanding this overlap could reveal novel therapeutic targets for CMT2V, potentially involving strategies to mitigate lysosomal dysfunction or enhance clearance pathways, which might also benefit patients with other lysosomal storage disorders. Conversely, insights into axonal maintenance could inform treatments for Scheie syndrome.
